test_title: PYST 68: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e3d2a708486d50184e987b1d1850c06ebfe7ae66ab52753c4b2c85fa0771145.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:

Top-right, middle and bottom-middle symbols are interchanging their position in circular manner.

Middle-left and bottom-right symbols are interchanged and middle-right and bottom-left symbols are interchanged their position.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

Top-right, bottom-right, bottom-middle and bottom-left symbols are interchanging their position in anticlockwise direction.

All 3 middle symbols are shifting their position in circular manner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8ba4ecab5e3404314a65e0d614106c1a865033933439442da3fff30f64f563f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
